$description: Audio targets. The 'pulse' is the sonic mài: a barely-noticed rhythmic bed that the whole edit is timed to (inspired by the ticking watch under Dunkirk's score).

pulse.rule: Cut points and caption onsets land on pulse subdivisions (1/2 or 1/4 beat).

sfx.strip: each removed layer = audible drop-out, not a fade

dialogue.$description: Two-voice conversation (guide leads, learner asks). Timings in seconds.
dialogue.casting: Contrast timbre AND accent/pitch so voices are told apart in under a second (e.g. low US male guide + bright UK female learner). Never two similar voices.
